identity_label: Sequence-consistent APOBEC3A–human APOBEC1 chimera; consistent with Pro.hAPOBEC1 architecture, exact published construct identity not confirmed
boundary_caution: 70–153 is the maximal exact APOBEC1 block observed. H70 and IM152–153 also match A3A; sequence alone does not determine the engineered splice junction exactly.

sources.claim: Official human APOBEC3A reference sequence; downloaded 2026-09-14
Official human APOBEC1 reference sequence; downloaded 2026-09-14
Han et al. 2025 report ProAPOBECs with other APOBEC deaminase cores and A3A terminal regions, including Pro.hAPOBEC1. Architecture supports interpretation; exact construct sequence not checked.

Kouno et al. 2017: A3A E72A catalytically inactivated with active-site geometry intact; N57/T31 involved in substrate positioning; A3A H70/C101/C106 coordinate Zn. Only transferable unchanged/reference-aligned residue identities used.
Grünewald et al. 2019 discuss APOBEC1 catalytic residues H61/E63/C93/C96. Exact human sequence block provides mapping to uploaded H70/E72/C102/C105.

Official human APOBEC1 annotations downloaded: E63 active site (proton donor), H61/C93/C96 catalytic Zn binding. These UniProt annotations are by similarity (ECO:0000250), not experiments on the current chimera.
Official human A3A CMP/dCMP-type deaminase domain annotation 27–143 (PROSITE prediction); this interval is reference-only and not treated as experimentally bounded current chimera domain.

interpretation_limits: Whole 199-aa construct is a deaminase module. The 70–153 segment is its APOBEC1-derived core, not an independently delimited complete catalytic domain.
Catalytic chemistry, substrate recognition and structural hotspot scores are distinct annotations.
Protein-only CP does not directly observe RNA recognition or catalytic rate.
Do not infer activities in C295/C388/C871 from the sequence annotation.
Uploaded W130 and M132 map to APOBEC1 W121 and M123. A3A Y130/Y132 function must not be assigned based on numeric labels.
domain_reference_note: UniProt annotates A3A CMP/dCMP-type deaminase domain as 27–143 and APOBEC1 as 10–134 (PROSITE rule). These are reference annotations; no claim that source segment 70–153 equals whole catalytic domain.
